title: Olive and the Lost Charm
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 1, week 2 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell i, o, o, u
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ch as k/sh, ow as oa.

pages.text: Olive has a shiny charm on a string.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl wearing a small shiny charm on a thin string around her neck, standing by the garden gate.

pages.text: The string snaps at the garden gate.
pages.illustration: The string breaking, the charm dropping away from Olive near the garden gate.

pages.text: Olive gasps. "My charm! It is gone!"
pages.illustration: Olive the owl looking down at her neck with a shocked expression, the charm nowhere in sight.

pages.text: Olive goes back to the plant pot.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl walking back along the path to a large plant pot.

pages.text: No charm sits by the plant pot.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl searching around the base of the plant pot, finding nothing.

pages.text: Olive goes back to the log.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl walking further back along the path toward an old log.

pages.text: No charm sits on the log.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl checking the top and sides of the log, still no charm.

pages.text: Olive goes right back to the gate.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl returning to the garden gate where the string first snapped.

pages.text: The charm sits in the grass by the gate.
pages.illustration: The small shiny charm resting in the grass right at the base of the garden gate.

pages.text: Olive grins and picks it up at last.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl smiling with relief, picking the charm up out of the grass.
